about_the_game:
Step into the whimsical world of Misc. A Tiny Tale through its heartfelt original soundtrack. Composed by Bernard A. Kyer and featuring singer songwritter RAYM, this collection of gentle melodies and uplifting tunes accompanies Buddy and Bag Boy on their tiny adventure.

Every track is crafted to celebrate friendship, self-discovery, and the joy of being different.

This release includes 30 tracks featured in the game, available in high-quality.
